title: Permutation in String
summary: Decide whether some rearrangement of one string appears as a contiguous piece of another.

tests.explain: "bca" (indices 2 to 4) uses exactly the letters of "abc".
Every 3-letter stretch of "acxb" contains an x, so none rearranges into "abc".
s1 is longer than s2, so it can't fit.

hints: A rearrangement of s1 has exactly s1.length characters, with exactly s1's letter counts.
Slide a window of fixed length s1.length over s2 and keep letter counts for the window.
Compare the window's counts with s1's counts after each slide (26 numbers), or track how many letters currently differ so each slide costs O(1).

complexity.time: O(n + m): one pass over s2 after counting s1, with O(1) work per slide
